notes.title: 0.5.1-alpha patch notes
notes.content: Fixed an issue that caused warriors to deal 100 times more damage than intended

notes.title: Patch 0.5.0-alpha: Druid, Bots, Endless Mode
notes.content:
- Added playable Druid class
- Added "Helper Bots", allowing you to add AI-controlled allies to your levels and campaigns
- Added Endless Mode

notes.title: Update notes for Nov. 29
notes.content:
- Added Omnidrone playable class
- Added damage and healing combat text
- Added stun combat text
- Added warrior attack sound effects
